steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Ah, is this Director Lunorey, Rhine Lab's youngest director ever, Dr. Wright's former right-hand woman, and supervisor of the Vivarium and Propeller Paradise's Engineering Department?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: ...Is this the 'follow-up' matter that you were talking about, Mercia?

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Well, yes. A guide can improve communication in the Engineering Department, and promotional efforts for the Rhine Vivarium, avoiding another frosty reception for Rhine, like what happened at the preview.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: I hear the botanical units floating above Propeller Paradise get their lift from incantations, rather than propellers?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Not entirely. Incantations that do not use sound as a medium need to be combined with machinery to maintain operation.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Your bone pen must be extremely important to you. Would losing it have negative consequences, such as loss of memory or illness?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: The bone pen is just a tool. It does not have... physiological effects.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: How do you relieve stress and recover your energy outside of work?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Does a full-course horn treatment help you relax? Which brand of horn-care product do you recommend? May I touch your horn to see how well it works—

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: You're asking questions that have nothing to do with our work. I'll have a researcher take you through the Vivarium, to answer any questions you may have.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: There are some things that I need to speak with Mercia here about. Alone.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: What is Gordon planning this time?

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Why do you ask? Mr. Tannen understands that Rhine's current circumstances may give competitors certain ideas, and he does not wish to see it impact the inspection efforts.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: He has the best of intentions.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: I thought he already traded his conscience for that fancy suit.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Besides, I have a hard time believing that an official guide would ask such irrelevant questions, unless she had ulterior motives to begin with.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: I'm not making any accusations. I know you have to protect your boss. But you know you can tell me the truth.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: ...I agree it's unusual, but I don't think Mr. Tannen is targeting you.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Explain.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: We've only just recently come to an accord. There's no reason for us to put pressure on you a second time, in such a short period of time.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Mr. Tannen is a careful man. He would have told me about it if he had other intentions, if only to avoid accidents. Unless...

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Unless he's keeping some kind of secret.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: He disappears from the office at certain times during the day, every day. At first, I thought he was going out to talk to potential investors.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: But I spoke to an investor a few days ago, who complimented Mr. Tannen on getting a contract signed in a single sitting.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Yet he said his negotiations with this particular investor were rocky and needed more time...

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Um... why are you looking at me like that?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: You just violated the First Rule of Secretaries.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Oh!

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Besides, you're not as tense as you used to be, when going over the clues.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: ...Is that so?

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: According to the rules, I should close my ears and mouth and think only about the interests of my boss. But now, I'm not sure what he's thinking.
Were you two talking about me?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: I'm glad to see the two of you getting along so well. Merry's a shy girl and I thought she would have trouble making friends outside of work.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Mr. Tannen, I...

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Is this part of her rules too?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Haha. You're a helluva joker, you know that?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: I hope you're not here for the comedy.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: I'm here to apologize.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: I know how exhausting it must be, inspecting thousands of exhibits while preparing your own at the same time. I just wanted to do my part to help.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: You sent a very professional guide.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: It's only natural to be nervous when meeting your hero.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: I never knew I had a fan like that.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: She must be shy, or maybe—

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: You were trying to avoid suspicion.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Bring the guide, Merry. I have a few questions about Director Lunorey that I would like to ask her.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: She's gone, sir...

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Say what—

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: Director Lunorey! Nutrition supply to all planters has been cut! But there's no error from the control program, and no sign of hardware damage to the central control computer. It's almost as if...

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: The command to control them has been revoked.

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: Yes. The converters that were supposed to supply energy to the planters are now running in reverse. The plants will die in minutes if the commands aren't repaired quickly—

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: No, they've already begun to wilt.
First the leaves, then the branches, and the trunks... the greenery that covered the lab walls is peeled off in a matter of seconds.
Everyone stops to watch the disaster unfolding before their very eyes. They all know what the shriveled, bony branches signify.
It is not just the trees in desperate straits.

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: What are you standing there for? Hurry up and move the saplings for the exhibition. Those are our last ones—

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Everybody freeze!

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Propeller Paradise Police will take control of the Vivarium, effective immediately, and begin an investigation into this incident. No one may approach the equipment until evidence collection is complete!

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Security!

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Put the Vivarium on lockdown.

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: I'm sorry you lost your experiments, Director Lunorey, but I have to ensure the safety of Propeller Paradise.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Your researchers have to leave the lab until the investigation is complete. I'll get someone else to handle the inspections.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: When did those guards show up outside the door? Before the alarm sounded, or after?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: I don't know what you're talking about.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: The researchers can leave. I won't.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Your timing was a little too perfect, Gordon.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*...

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Thank goodness... no one's on my tail...

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Sorry, Mr. Tannen, I'll have to go back on my promise to meet you in the Vivarium.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: I think I found what I need to help the Banshee...

a.text: Ferne opens up her hand. A white object is lying in her palm.
Ten minutes ago, she was walking through the Vivarium, while thinking about what can help restore an aging Banshee's mind.
It must be something that is very important to a Banshee, something that would awaken her instincts.
The small object inserted into a tree caught Ferne's eye, as though ordained by fate.
The white surface is covered in esoteric symbols, patterns floating around it like a glowing cardiograph, its allure irresistible.
Ferne has seen similar symbols and patterns before. It is a Banshee bone pen.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Sorry, Director Lunorey, but I'll have to borrow this for a while. I'll return it as soon as my client has recovered.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Hello! Sorry to keep you cooped up in this room all day. I think I found a way to restore your memories—

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: ...Ma'am?
There is no one in the room. Only the creased sheets show any indication that someone used to be here.
Wind blows into the room through the open window. A black feather that fell from a horn quivers on the windowsill.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: She's... gone...
